issues.description: The advertised tiny extraction path requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo's data/stories directory is empty.
The end-to-end test fails at extraction, so the demo workflow is not reproducible from the checked-in repo.
make demo invokes extraction against the missing story corpus, so the primary README demo command fails.
HF preference scoring asks for a numeric preference score but measures the next-token logit gap for ' good' versus ' bad', making the Elo validation scientifically unreliable.
Validation recreates the backend from CLI config instead of enforcing compatibility with the vector manifest, allowing stale or mismatched vectors/backends to crash or produce invalid results.
Preference steering also ignores backend/model compatibility from the manifest before loading vectors and constructing a backend.
HF activation extraction has no max-length, truncation, batching, or OOM handling, so long stories can exceed context limits or memory.
activity_activation returns the final prompt-token activation rather than activity-token activations, contradicting the preference-correlation method described in the README.
pca_components_for_variance returns one component when threshold is 0, although zero explained variance should require zero components.
The installed console script depends on external config/data files that are not packaged, so emovec defaults fail outside the repo checkout.
